test_title: PYST 9: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 04 Aug, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Directions: Each of the following questions has underlined idioms/phrases. Each sentence is followed by four options. Choose the option that best describes the meaning of the underlined idiom/phrase.

After procrastinating for weeks, I finally had to __bite the bullet__ and ask my boss for a raise.

options.text: To endure a painful or difficult situation with courage and determination
To take the easy way out

solution:
The correct answer is **"To endure a painful or difficult situation with courage and determination."**
